t: A Turkmen tribal confederation led by the Bayandur clan, based first at Diyarbakır and from 1469 at Tabriz.
Under Uzun Hasan it destroyed the Qara Qoyunlu and the Timurid Abu Sa’id to rule Iran, Iraq and eastern Anatolia.
Defeated by the Ottomans in 1473, it split after 1490 and gave way to the Safavid state of Uzun Hasan’s grandson Ismail.
dyk: Shah Ismail I, founder of the Safavid dynasty that overthrew the Aq Qoyunlu, was Uzun Hasan’s grandson through his daughter by the Trebizond princess Theodora Komnene.
ev: Qara Yuluk Osman defeats and kills Kadi Burhan al-Din
Uzun Hasan defeats and kills the Qara Qoyunlu ruler Jahan Shah
Uzun Hasan defeats the Timurid Abu Sa’id and makes Tabriz his capital
Mehmed II defeats Uzun Hasan at the Battle of Otlukbeli
Death of Ya’qub opens a decade of succession wars
Ismail defeats Alvand at Sharur and takes Tabriz
Ismail defeats Murad near Hamadan, ending Aq Qoyunlu rule
